title: New Mosque
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Yeni Camii:central windowed drum/lead dome with four cascading semi-domes,small corner caps and stepped capped buttress turrets,two three-balcony minarets,open domed pointed courtyard,raised prayer-hall portal,octagonal domed grille-front fountain and two-storey exterior side galleries. Exact mapped whole/court/fountain;internal and vertical partitions are picture-proportioned estimates. Five shared material graphs,six merged roles,four browser levels.
